name: s81dv_idxrg2-s81dv_idxrg2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 idxrd2 row-abutting regional index reader/scorer dsdv_idx_rg (x16 a die, MU.BAL.SX.3 / MU.S81.L20.SPLIT) on 1024x256 SRAM to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_idx_rg #(.SRAM_MACRO(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx_arith.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_idx.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/idx/dsdv_idx_rg.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: idxrd_base
bench.note: idxrd2 RTL (1024x256 memories, scale row cache, item-queue SRAM): same operating points as 4cc3975d1 (scan P=3, gather P=4) + spec om open lanes

bench.name: idxrd_mut1
bench.note: MUT 1: lane hash off by one

bench.name: idxrd_mut2
bench.note: MUT 2: rk always returned to the slice

bench.name: idxrd_mut3
bench.note: MUT 3: scale lane of the neighbouring cell

bench.name: idxrd_mut4
bench.note: MUT 4: region 0 part-1 beat one cycle late

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxrg2 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_idx_rg --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-L20 idxrd2 (owner 12:42 row-abutting 16-reader direction; SAFE checklist after the 256x256 face finding): every memory on ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 (faces 5.89 contacts/um <= 6; 256x256 is 10.0/um); scale register file (2x128x32 b) and item-queue flops (256x29 b) moved into SRAM (scale rows in the landing half-0 macro + write-through row cache; item-queue macro + 3-entry show-ahead head); outline 518.4 x 777.6 = the reader row slot of the idxrd2 die plan (dv_plan --idxrd 2: any taller reader puts die lanes over block bodies -> the row height is fixed).
